vehicle: Suzuki Jimny Sierra JB74 (2018-), also JB64 / JC74 where noted
scope: Three auxiliary-lighting briefs for the 3D configurator: (1) STEDI amber roof-line bar, (2) six KC HiLiTES round lights on a roof rack, (3) a grille / behind-grille bar. Every dimension is flagged verified:true only when it came off the maker's own spec table; everything else is marked and reasoned.
researchNote: WebSearch quota for the session was exhausted before the first query, so all of this was gathered by direct WebFetch against maker and dealer sites, with html.duckduckgo.com proxied through r.jina.ai standing in for a search engine. ~45 fetches. Google, Bing, Brave, Startpage, Ecosia, Mojeek, Yandex and Shopee were all unreachable or CAPTCHA-walled; Baidu worked for two queries then CAPTCHA'd. Instagram and Mobile01 build threads could not be read at all, so no fitted-photo measurements are in here.
rules: JB74 roof load is 30 kg dynamic. That is the binding constraint on every roof-lighting option here, not the rack's own rating: a Rhino-Rack Pioneer platform is ~14-18 kg on its own, so a 6.62 kg ST4K 52in or an 11.3 kg KC Pro6 6-light bar can put the car over the limit before anything else goes up there. The ST3K 51.5in at 4.25 kg is the only full-width bar with real margin.

A JB74 roof platform is 1240-1380 mm wide. Rhino-Rack's Jimny kits: Pioneer 6 1300 x 1240 mm, Pioneer 6 1500 x 1380 mm, ROLS1 Overlanding kit 1453 x 1339 mm. The brief's '~1300 mm rack' is correct and 52in / 1320 mm is the natural full-width bar length.

STEDI amber comes in four different physical forms and they do not look the same on the car: (a) a bonded selective-yellow LENS, factory, ST1K 21.5in only - the bar is yellow-faced even when off; (b) a removable amber FILTER COVER that clips over the lens - ST3K, ST4K, ST3301/ST3303 Pro, Sport Plus - the bar reads as a flat amber panel and the 5700K output becomes ~2500K; (c) a 2700K warm-white LED with a clear lens - Micro V2 amber - the bar looks white/clear when off and amber only when lit; (d) touch-switched dual colour white + amber DRL - ST2K TOUCH only.

STEDI does NOT make an inner-grille or behind-grille bracket for the Jimny. They make them for Ranger, Ranger Raptor, Everest, Prado 150/250, Hilux N80, Y62 Patrol, LC300 and Amarok. The only JB74-specific STEDI front mount is the Rally Bar, which sits in FRONT of the grille.

KC does not sell a six-light Daylighter or SlimLite bar. Six rounds is either the Pro6 factory 6-light bar (one assembly, 994 mm) or six individual lamps bolted separately to the rack - two quite different silhouettes.
The 'smiley' is a real, current KC part: 5114, black cover with a yellow smiley face, Gravity Titan/Pro6 6in fitment. The plain black-with-yellow-KC-logo cover is 5111. Both are USD 18.99 / TWD 600.

products.name: ST3K 51.5 Inch 50 LED Slim LED Light Bar + Amber Filter Cover
products.depthNote: NOT PUBLISHED. STEDI publishes height only for the whole ST3K range. Defensible estimate 55-65 mm for the extrusion body, 75-85 mm once the side brackets and fixings are counted - reasoned from STEDI's own single-row ST1K, which publishes 38 mm height against 80 mm depth where that depth figure demonstrably includes the bottom mounts. Treat as low confidence; do not quote it as a spec.
products.segmentNote: 50 discrete Osram Oslon emitters in one row, pitch 1300/50 = 26 mm. Reads as a continuous lit line at any normal viewing distance, not as cubes.
products.amberDetail: Removable ST3K amber filter cover, AUD 25.00 in 51.5in. STEDI: renders the 5700K output to a warm ~2500K. Functional, not cosmetic. With it fitted the bar face is a flat amber panel edge to edge.
products.mount: Roof rack front rail, or windscreen header via third-party brackets
products.mountBracket: 3 mm powder-coated stainless steel side brackets (supplied). STEDI's own LED Light Bar Bracket to suit Rhino Rack Platform (AUD 129, 4 mm stainless, textured finish matched to the Rhino-Rack) carries it either directly underneath or directly in front of the platform, with slotted holes for height and fore-aft adjustment.

tw.seller: Jimny Plus International Co Ltd (STEDI's listed Taiwan dealer), No. 557 Tanmei St, Neihu District, Taipei, 0926 706 982; trades as STEDI Taiwan, IG @stedi_taiwan, Shopee shopee.tw/stedi.tw
tw.priceNote: No TWD price list reachable - Shopee TW blocks unauthenticated reads. Typical TW landed markup on AU list is 1.4-1.7x, so expect roughly TWD 11,000-13,500 for the bar; NOT verified.

products.modelling: The lowest-profile way to put a full-width bar across a JB74 roof. 1300 mm spans essentially the whole platform width, so the silhouette change is a single crisp horizontal line sitting 63 mm proud of the rack's front edge - from the side it barely raises the roofline at all, which is the point of the ST3K. Face is a one-piece bonded lens with no visible cube divisions; with the amber filter on, that face goes from near-black/grey to a flat warm orange, which is the single biggest colour event on the front three-quarter view of the car. Side brackets are stainless and stay silver unless specified otherwise, so there are two small bright tabs at the ends. At 4.25 kg it is the only full-width bar that leaves real roof-load headroom.

products.name: ST3K 41.5 Inch 40 LED Slim LED Light Bar + Amber Filter Cover
products.amberDetail: ST3K amber filter cover, AUD 22.50 in 41.5in.
products.mount: Roof rack front rail or windscreen header
products.mountBracket: 3 mm powder-coated stainless side brackets
products.modelling: The inset option: 1055 mm on a 1240-1380 mm rack leaves 90-160 mm of bare rail showing at each end, so the bar reads as a deliberate element rather than as the rack's own front edge. Same 51/63 mm section as the 51.5in.

products.name: ST3K 21.5 Inch 20 LED Slim LED Light Bar + Amber Filter Cover
products.amberDetail: ST3K amber filter cover, AUD 17.50 in 21.5in.
products.mount: Roof rack front rail (centre), bull bar, or bonnet
products.mountBracket: 3 mm powder-coated stainless side brackets
products.modelling: Half-width centre bar. Useful as the 'one small amber stripe' state in the configurator - much less visually dominant than a full-width bar.

products.name: ST1K 21.5 Inch E-Mark LED Light Bar - Yellow
products.lengthNote: Product page says 546 mm; the series listing page says 550 mm. Both are STEDI's own copy. Use 546.
products.depthNote: STEDI's published 80 mm depth includes the heavy-duty adjustable bottom mounts. Body-only depth is not published.
products.segmentNote: 20 x 5 W OSRAM behind a single edge-to-edge bonded lens - no visible cube separations at all, this is STEDI's flushest-faced bar.
products.amberDetail: The ONLY STEDI bar with factory colour built in: an edge-to-edge bonded YELLOW lens, not a clip-on filter and not an amber LED. It is selective yellow rather than true amber, and the bar is yellow-faced whether lit or not. Same AUD 219 as the white version, same 5,920 lm.
products.mount: Roof rack front rail, windscreen header, bull bar
products.mountBracket: Heavy-duty adjustable BOTTOM mounts plus a side bracket - both supplied. The only STEDI bar in this set that ships with a true bottom-mount option, which matters if it sits on top of a rack rail rather than hanging off its face.
products.modelling: At 38 mm tall this is the slimmest bar STEDI sells and the yellow face is permanent, so on the model it is a thin bright-yellow horizontal stripe even in the daytime/unlit state - a much stronger styling statement than an amber filter cover on a dark ST3K face, and the reason people fit it on a windscreen header where it sits at eye level. Hooded reflector design gives the face a subtle stepped shadow under each emitter. E-marked (ECE), which is why it is the one to put on a road-registered car in a market that checks.

products.name: ST4K 52 Inch 100 LED Double Row Light Bar + Amber Filter Cover
products.segmentNote: 100 OSRAM Oslon in TWO rows of 50, reflector split 16 flood + 68 spot + 16 flood. Double-row face is visibly a grid, not a line.
products.amberDetail: ST4K amber filter cover, AUD 30.00 in 52in. 5700K rendered to ~2500K.
products.mount: Roof rack front rail; also the MG-X JB74 gutter brackets, which are sized for a 52in bar
products.mountBracket: Brushed 304 stainless side brackets, 3 mm, plus adjustable sliding bottom mounts with +/-15 mm height adjustment
products.modelling: The loud option. 110 mm tall and 105 mm deep, it is twice the section of an ST3K and reads as a slab across the roof - the classic 4WD roof-bar silhouette. Full-width at 1320 mm. Note the height is not constant across the ST4K range: the 22in publishes 87 mm and the 52in 110 mm, so if you model one ST4K profile it will be wrong for the other length. At 6.62 kg plus a 14-18 kg rack this is the option that eats the JB74's 30 kg roof limit.

products.name: ST4K 22 Inch 40 LED Double Row Light Bar + Amber Filter Cover
products.amberDetail: ST4K amber filter cover, AUD 20.00 in 22in.
products.mount: Roof rack front rail (centre), bull bar, Rally Bar
products.mountBracket: Brushed 304 stainless side brackets 3 mm + adjustable sliding mounts, +/-15 mm
products.modelling: Half-width double-row. 87 x 100 mm section on a 560 mm bar makes it look chunky and short - a very different read from the long thin ST3K.

products.name: ST2K TOUCH 40 Inch Curved LED Light Bar (white / amber dual function)
products.dimNote: Height and depth NOT PUBLISHED for the TOUCH. The non-touch ST2K Curved 40.5in publishes 1028 x 87 x 95 mm and is the same 6063 extrusion family - use that as the proxy section and say so.
products.segmentNote: 16 x 15 W main-beam LEDs plus a separate DRL strip, curved in plan.
products.amberDetail: The only genuinely dual-function STEDI bar. The main beam is white; the DRL strip switches by touch between pure white and warm amber. So the bar has three distinct visual states to model - off (dark curved face), white DRL, amber DRL - plus main beam.
products.mount: Roof rack front rail, bull bar
products.mountBracket: Stainless steel side brackets; STEDI lists it as compatible with Rhino-Rack, Yakima and ARB platforms
products.modelling: Curved in plan, so on a flat-fronted JB74 rack the ends stand off the rail and the centre tucks in - it never sits flush against a straight front rail, which is the main reason to model it separately from the ST3K/ST4K. The amber here is a thin DRL line rather than the whole face, so the amber state is a glowing orange stripe within a dark bar, not a solid orange panel.

products.name: ST3303 Pro 28.2 Inch 40 LED Double Row Ultra High Output
products.segmentNote: 40 CREE XPL in two rows of 20. The ST3303 face is the most obviously 'cube-per-LED' of the STEDI range.
products.amberDetail: ST3303 Pro optional covers, amber filter or blackout, from AUD 20. Separately, PRO Colour Caps (AUD 20/pair) replace the END CAPS ONLY in yellow/red/blue/green/sandy tan/orange - they colour the two ends of the housing, not the lens. The 28.2in ships with orange and grey end caps in the box.
products.mount: Roof rack front rail, bull bar, Rally Bar
products.mountBracket: Cast alloy adjustable sliding bracket + 4 mm 304 stainless side brackets
products.modelling: Short, tall and deep - 717 x 98 x 105 mm is nearly square in section. Distinctive because the coloured end caps are a separate body-colour element, so the bar can be modelled as dark centre + coloured ends. Same 717 mm length as the Bushranger behind-grille bar, which is a handy cross-check on 28in = 717 mm.

products.name: ST3303 Pro 23.3 Inch 32 LED Double Row Ultra High Output
products.mount: Roof rack front rail, bull bar
products.mountBracket: Cast alloy adjustable sliding bracket + 4 mm stainless side brackets
products.modelling: Note the section is NOT constant along the ST3303 range: 11in is 89 x 85, 23.3in is 87 x 98, 28.2in is 98 x 105. Model each length from its own numbers.

products.name: ST3303 Pro 11 Inch 12 LED Double Row Ultra High Output
products.lengthNote: Product page says 280 mm; the series listing page says 246 mm. Both are STEDI copy. 280 mm is probably over the side brackets, 246 mm the housing. PRICE CONFLICT-style discrepancy - do not silently pick one.
products.mount: Bull bar, Rally Bar, bonnet, A-pillar
products.mountBracket: Cast alloy adjustable sliding bracket + 4 mm stainless side brackets
products.modelling: Small enough to sit centrally on the STEDI Rally Bar or in a bumper void. Too deep (85 mm) to hide behind a JB74 grille.

products.name: Micro V2 26 Inch 48 LED Flood Light (2700K amber)
products.segmentNote: 48 x OSRAM GW PSLR in one row behind a flat polycarbonate lens.
products.amberDetail: This is a 2700K warm-white emitter with a CLEAR lens, not a filter and not a true amber LED. Unlit it looks like the white version; lit it is warm orange. STEDI markets the 5700K and 2700K versions side by side at the same AUD 99.
products.mount: Roof rack (side, rear or under-rail), awning rail, bumper void
products.mountBracket: 304 stainless side brackets supplied. STEDI's Roof Rack Light Bracket pairs exist for the 7.8in (AUD 60) and 13.9in (AUD 70) ONLY - an 8 mm channel-nut clamp for any Rhino-Rack or ARB channel rack, holding the light horizontally. There is no published roof-rack bracket for the 26in.
products.modelling: A camp/flood light, not a driving bar - 48 W, 5,100 lm, flood beam only. Worth modelling because at 25 x 40.6 mm it is by far the slimmest amber element available and it disappears under a rack rail: from the side it is a 25 mm dark sliver. Good for the 'amber glow under the rack' look rather than a front-facing bar.

products.name: Micro Touch Dual Colour 13.9 Inch
products.dimNote: STEDI prints these as L/H/D 353 x 39.2 x 26.3 mm, but the sibling Micro V2 26in prints 665 x 25 x 40.6 with the SAME extrusion family - i.e. one of the two listings has height and depth swapped. Assume the body is ~25-26 mm in one axis and ~39-41 mm in the other and verify against a photo before modelling.
products.amberDetail: 24 x OSRAM S5. Pure white 5700K and warm amber 1500K, touch-switched and blendable between the two. The most saturated amber in the STEDI range at 1500K.
products.mount: Roof rack (via the 13.9in Roof Rack Light Bracket pair, AUD 70), awning rail
products.mountBracket: 46 mm 304 stainless side brackets supplied; the 13.9in roof-rack bracket pair is 3 mm stainless with M8 channel nuts
products.modelling: The cheapest way to get a genuine white-to-amber state change on the model. Tiny - 353 mm is a quarter of the rack width - so it is an accent, typically mounted on the rack side rail or rear, not across the front.

products.name: LED Light Bar Bracket to suit Rhino Rack Platform
products.dimNote: Bracket dimensions NOT PUBLISHED. STEDI states it accommodates bars in a ~984-1388 mm range depending on plank count and mounting position.
products.mount: Rhino-Rack Pioneer Platform / Tray / Tradie, 4- and 5-plank, old and new to 2023
products.mountBracket: Two-piece, 4 mm stainless, textured finish matched to the Rhino-Rack extrusion. Bolts into the platform channel and slides fore-aft; the light-bar mounting points are slotted for height. Holds the bar EITHER directly underneath the platform OR directly in front of it - two different silhouettes from one part. Pioneer 6 fitment needs the outer air guides removed and Zwifloc fasteners used.
products.modelling: This is the part that decides whether the amber bar reads as a lip on the rack's front face or as a hidden strip tucked under it. Fits ST2K, ST3K, ST3301, ST3303 Pro, ST4K and ST-X. The JB74 relevance is direct: Rhino-Rack is the most common JB74 platform in AU and its Jimny kits are 1240-1380 mm wide.

products.name: MG-X Gutter Mounted Light Bar Brackets (JB64 / JB74 / JC74)
products.dimNote: No dimensions or material published. Sold as a pair.
products.mount: Clamps onto the Jimny's roof GUTTER CHANNELS - no drilling, no rack needed
products.mountBracket: Pair of clamp brackets, sized for a 52 inch bar
products.modelling: The JB74-specific alternative to a roof platform: the bar hangs between two gutter clamps just above the windscreen header, i.e. at the very front of the roof and lower than a rack-mounted bar. Sized for 52in (1320 mm), which matches the ST4K 52in and is 20 mm longer than the ST3K 51.5in. This is the silhouette most JB74 owners actually have - a bar on the roof edge with no rack behind it. Fits 3-door JB64/JB74 and 5-door JC74.

products.name: 39 Inch Gravity Pro6 LED 6-Light Bar (91307)
products.lengthNote: KC publishes 39.125 in = 993.8 mm, and 99.4 cm in metric.
products.segmentNote: Six 6 inch round lamps on one aluminium backbone with aluminium end mounts. Outer lamps are Wide-40 optics, middle lamps are Spot - so the beam inserts differ across the bar even though the lamps look identical.
products.lampPitchNote: DERIVED, not published. KC's own configuration table runs 3-light 20in, 4-light 26in, 5-light 32in, 6-light 39in, 7-light 45in, 8-light 50in, 9-light 57in. A least-squares fit gives length = 6.167 x n + 1.5 inches, i.e. a per-lamp pitch of 6.167 in = 156.6 mm and a fixed 1.5 in (38 mm) of end hardware. Checked against the one bar KC publishes real dimensions for, the 7-light 91347 at 45.625 in / 1159 mm: 6 x 156.6 + 152.4 lamp diameter + ~67 mm of end mounts = 1159 mm. Exact. So lamps sit with only ~4 mm of daylight between their 152.4 mm rims - the classic nose-to-tail Pro6 look.
products.amberDetail: The bar ships with SIX black covers carrying the yellow KC logo (that is the 'smiley' look). Amber is available as a hard-plastic amber shield, part 5112, USD 18.99 each, fitting Gravity Titan/Pro6 6in. The 50th-anniversary black cover with a yellow SMILEY FACE is part 5114, USD 18.99 / TWD 600.
products.mount: Overhead - roof rack front rail, cage, or a vehicle-specific overhead bracket
products.mountBracket: High-strength aluminium end mounts, universal, sized to standard LED-bar widths. KC sells a centre-mount stabiliser assembly (91317, USD 63) for long spans, and vehicle-specific overhead bracket pairs (F150/Raptor 7379 USD 224.99, Can-Am X3 73425, RZR Pro R 73427) - but NO published Rhino-Rack or ARB platform bracket. The only rack-specific KC package is 91398, the 8-light 50in bar bundled with a Yakima LNL platform mount, sold in Taiwan by MRK at TWD 70,000.

tw.seller: MRK 台灣 (mrk.com.tw) carries KC HiLiTES. MRK lists the Gravity TITAN bar family (91413-91419, 20in-57in, TWD 56,000-111,000) and the Pro6 8-light + Yakima kit 91398 at TWD 70,000, but NOT the 6-light Pro6 bar 91307 itself.
tw.priceNote: By interpolation against MRK's Titan ladder, a 6-light Pro6 bar would land around TWD 60,000-80,000. NOT verified.

products.modelling: 994 x 154 x 85 mm as one rigid assembly. On a 1240-1380 mm JB74 rack it leaves 123-193 mm of bare rail at each end, so it reads as a centred block, not as a full-width element. The six 152 mm lamps nearly touch, giving a continuous scalloped front edge rather than six separate discs - this is the key difference from six individually mounted rounds. Each lamp has KC's black Infinity Ring bezel, which can be rotated to convert the bar from straight to radius (the lamps fan outward) - two distinct geometries from one part. With the black/yellow covers on, the front face is six black discs each with a yellow KC logo, which is exactly the 'smiley row' the brief is after. 11.3 kg is 38% of the JB74's entire 30 kg roof allowance before you add the rack.

products.name: Gravity Pro6 LED Single Light (91302)
products.dimNote: KC publishes 6 in diameter, 7 in height, 3.125 in depth. The 7 in height is the lamp plus its universal ball mount; the lamp body itself is 6 in.
products.amberDetail: Covers are per-lamp and interchangeable: 5111 black w/ yellow KC logo, 5114 black w/ yellow smiley face, 5112 amber shield, 5118 clear shield - all USD 18.99, all TWD 600 at MRK.
products.mount: Roof rack front rail, A-pillar/ditch, bumper
products.mountBracket: Universal BALL mount on a flat pad - the lamp pivots on a single stem, so six of them on a rail can each be aimed independently. This is the mechanism that makes six individually-mounted lamps look different from the Pro6 bar (where all six share one backbone).

tw.priceNote: MRK lists 91305, the 20 W spread pair, at TWD 19,000 for two.

products.modelling: The unit to instance six times for a hand-built rack layout. Black Infinity Ring bezel around a 152 mm lens, ball-mount stem below. Body depth only 79 mm, so it sits close to the rail - much shallower than a Daylighter.

products.name: 6 Inch Daylighter (halogen 100 W, and Gravity LED G6)
products.dimNote: KC publishes W 6.22 in x H 8.42 in x D 5.38 in for BOTH the halogen single and the Gravity LED G6 single (part 1653). 6.22 in = 158 mm across the bezel; 8.42 in = 214 mm is lamp + stem; 5.38 in = 137 mm is the deep reflector can.
products.amberDetail: Daylighter covers are the archetypal KC look: 5102 soft vinyl black w/ yellow KC logo (pair, USD 23.99 / TWD 650), 5100 black w/ white logo (pair, USD 20.99), 5200 hard black w/ white SMILEY (TWD 580), 7213 yellow stone guard w/ black KC logo (TWD 750), 7210 black stone guard w/ white logo (TWD 750). These are the covers that read as a 'smile' from a distance.
products.mount: Roof rack front rail, bull bar, Rally Bar
products.mountBracket: Single-stem pedestal mount through the housing's top bolt, stainless steel housing on the halogen / black powder-coated steel on the LED
products.weightNote: 3.1 lb for the LED G6, 3.0 lb class for the halogen.

tw.seller: MRK 台灣 lists the Daylighter COVERS and stone guards (TWD 580-750) but not the lamps themselves in the page reached.

products.modelling: The deep one. 137 mm of reflector behind a 158 mm bezel and 214 mm of total height means six of these on a rack front rail create a genuinely bulky front edge - much more visual mass than six Pro6 or SlimLite. Stainless (halogen) or black steel (LED). This is the shape everyone pictures when they say 'KC lights', and it is the one the soft vinyl black-and-yellow cover was designed around.

products.name: SlimLite 6 Inch LED - Master Kit (single 1106 / pair 0106)
products.dimNote: KC publishes W 6.22 in x H 6.79 in x D 2.88 in; the copy separately calls the housing 2.7 in deep.
products.amberDetail: SlimLite has its own shield range, NOT interchangeable with Pro6: 5104 amber shield USD 17.99, 5103 clear, 5109 black, 5121 SAE driving-beam selective yellow USD 19.99. Each master kit ships with a black cover carrying the yellow KC logo plus an SAE driving-beam shield.
products.mount: Roof rack front rail, A-pillar, bumper
products.mountBracket: Universal adjustable bracket with vertical adjustment

tw.seller: MRK 台灣, part 0106 (76 W spot, black, pair)

products.modelling: Same 158 mm face as a Daylighter but only 73 mm deep - half the reflector can. Six of these give the smiley row without the bulk; from the side the rack front edge stays thin. Aluminium alloy body, black. This is the best compromise if the configurator needs six rounds that do not dominate the roofline.

products.name: KC 6 inch light covers - the black/yellow 'smiley' family
products.amberDetail: Three distinct cover families that do NOT interchange: (a) Gravity Titan/Pro6 6in hard plastic - 5111 black w/ yellow KC logo, 5114 black w/ yellow SMILEY FACE (50th anniversary), 5112 AMBER shield, 5118 clear, all USD 18.99 / TWD 600; (b) 6in round general - 5102 soft vinyl black w/ yellow KC logo (pair) USD 23.99 / TWD 650, 5100 black w/ white logo (pair) USD 20.99, 5105 hard black w/ white KC logo USD 17.99, 5200 hard black w/ white smiley TWD 580; (c) SlimLite 6in shields - 5104 amber USD 17.99, 5103 clear, 5109 black, 5121 selective yellow USD 19.99. Rectangular vinyl covers also exist in YELLOW with a black KC logo (5601 5x7in, 5611 6x9in) - the inverse colourway, not available in 6in round.
products.mount: Snaps or straps over the lens
products.modelling: The whole 'smiley' read comes from this part, so it needs to be its own material/decal state in the configurator: a matt black disc with a yellow mark - either the KC wordmark (5111) or an actual smiley face (5114). Six of them in a row is the look. The amber shield (5112) is the alternative state and turns the same disc translucent orange.

products.name: 'Behind Grille' 28 Inch Light Bar Kit to suit Suzuki Jimny JB74 / JC74 (NHBGS450LB)
products.dimNote: Bushranger publishes only overall length 717 mm and a mounting-foot adjustment span of 642 mm for the NHT280VLI bar. Height and depth are NOT PUBLISHED by Bushranger, ARB or any reseller reached. Defensible estimate: 50-60 mm high, 60-75 mm deep including the two sliding feet - reasoned from (a) it is a single-row 6061 extrusion with 21 emitters over ~640 mm of lit length, a 30.5 mm LED pitch, versus STEDI's ST3K at 26 mm pitch and 51 mm published height, and (b) at 2.10 kg over 717 mm it is 2.93 kg/m, between STEDI's single-row ST1K at 2.36 kg/m (38 mm high) and the ST3K at 3.27 kg/m (51 mm high). Mark as estimate in the model.
products.segmentNote: 21 genuine OSRAM LEDs, single row, 90 W, 5700K, 7,360 effective lm, 755 m at 1 lux. Seven interchangeable beam covers supplied with the bare bar.
products.amberNote: No amber option published for this kit. Bushranger supplies flood and diffused beam covers, not colour filters.
products.mount: BEHIND THE LOWER GRILLE. Bushranger's own words: mounts 'behind the lower grille' on 'vehicle-specific, body-mounted brackets', needing 'only minor plastic trimming to the plastic lower radiator shroud'.
products.mountBracket: Jimny-specific body-mounted bracket kit, supplied with the kit and NOT sold separately. Kit also contains the wiring loom, an OEM-style switch and a headlight adaptor (it triggers off high beam). Incompatible with a bull bar or a hidden winch mount.
products.priceNote: AUD 600 for the JB74 kit at Bushranger and MegaJimny; the bare NHT280VLI bar is AUD 390 direct and AUD 500 at ARB bundled with a wiring system.

tw.note: No Taiwanese seller found for Bushranger.

products.modelling: This is the product the brief is really asking for, and the correction is that it is Bushranger, not STEDI - STEDI has no Jimny grille bracket at all. Geometry for the model: a 717 mm single-row bar sitting behind the JB74's LOWER front aperture (the wide black mesh panel under the number-plate line), centred, so it spans roughly +/-358 mm from the vehicle centreline. It is set back behind the plastic, so from straight on you see a dark horizontal band through the mesh and nothing protruding; from a three-quarter view it is essentially invisible. Lit, it is a bright horizontal line low on the bumper, well below the headlights - a completely different night signature from a roof or windscreen bar. The lower radiator shroud has to be trimmed for clearance, which implies the bar's rear face sits within ~40 mm of the shroud. NOTE the ambiguity: Bushranger says 'lower grille' while MegaJimny's copy just says 'behind the grille' - if the intended position is actually the upper slotted grille between the headlights, a 717 mm bar would be wider than that aperture, which is the strongest single argument for the lower position.
products.verifiedNote: Length, LED count, weight, material, part number, price and the 'behind the lower grille' wording are all verified from Bushranger and ARB. Cross-section is not.

products.name: STEDI Rally Bar to suit JB74 Jimny 2018+ (ST-11-JMN-001)
products.dimNote: Overall width, height and forward projection are NOT PUBLISHED. STEDI gives only the 63 mm tube diameter, 2 mm wall, 5.3 kg mass and a 30 kg load rating; a technical drawing exists on the page but its figures are in the image, not the text, and could not be read. Do not invent a span - model it from a photo.
products.mount: IN FRONT OF THE GRILLE. A stainless hoop across the nose, the 'stylistic and practical alternative to bulky bull bars and unsightly nudge bars' in STEDI's copy. Fitted with a supplied template and STEP DRILL BIT, so it drills into the vehicle's front bodywork; STEDI still calls it 'fully reversible'.
products.mountBracket: Carries lights via 60-66 mm hex brackets, sold separately. 30 kg load.

products.modelling: The only JB74-specific front mount STEDI makes, and it is the opposite of a behind-grille bar: a 63 mm polished stainless tube standing proud in front of the grille, carrying driving lights or a short bar on hex clamps. It changes the front silhouette substantially - the car gains a visible hoop and whatever is clamped to it. 5.3 kg. Because it drills the body it is not a bolt-on in the way the Bushranger kit is.
products.verifiedNote: Part number, price, tube diameter, wall, weight, load and contents verified. Overall geometry not.

products.name: JB74 Express Grille Deluxe (grille insert with 2 integrated light bars)
products.dimNote: No dimensions published. The bars are described only as '2x 6W light bars' - length, LED count and colour temperature all unpublished.
products.amberNote: Colour not stated; assume white unless confirmed.
products.mount: IN THE GRILLE APERTURE. A metal grille insert that is a straight swap for the factory grille using all factory clips; the two light bars are held by the insert itself, so they sit in the plane of the grille rather than in front of or behind it.
products.mountBracket: Integral - the insert IS the bracket. Wiring not included.
products.modelling: The third of the three possible grille geometries, and the only one where the light sits IN the grille plane: replace the factory grille panel and two small bars appear within its openings. Fits JB74 and JC74XL. Visually this is the most integrated option - no hoop in front, no hidden bar below - but it changes the grille panel itself, so the model needs a swapped grille mesh, not just an added light.
products.verifiedNote: Product existence, construction, fitment and price verified; all dimensions unpublished.

products.name: Grille Marker EXJ-12 (amber) / EXJ-12W (white) for the factory JB64/JB74/JC74 grille
products.dimNote: IPF publishes no dimensions for the markers.
products.segmentNote: Four separate marker lamps, 12 V 1.6 W each, under 300 cd so road legal in Japan.
products.amberDetail: EXJ-12 is an ORANGE lens over an orange LED in an ASA resin bezel - genuinely amber hardware, not a filter. EXJ-12W is the white equivalent at the same price. EXJ-13 / EXJ-13W is the same kit for the Suzuki genuine option grille.
products.mount: IN THE GRILLE APERTURES. IPF: 取付けはグリル既存の開口部に差し込み固定するだけ - the markers push into the grille's existing openings and clip, no cutting, plug-in harness, and IPF says they can go どこでも (anywhere) among the available openings.
products.mountBracket: None - the markers are the fixing.
products.modelling: The cheapest and most recognisable grille change: four small amber dots in a row across the factory grille, giving the Raptor look. Already catalogued in jb74-accessory-atlas.json. Because IPF says the markers can go in any of the openings, the configurator should let the four positions move rather than hard-coding them.

layouts.desc: Six KC rounds as ONE factory assembly: the Gravity Pro6 6-light bar 91307 laid along the front rail of a JB74 roof rack
layouts.note: Pitch 156.6 mm is DERIVED from KC's own 3-to-9-light length ladder (length = 6.167 in x n + 1.5 in) and confirmed against the only multi-light bar KC publishes real dimensions for, the 7-light 91347 at 1159 mm. With a 152.4 mm lamp diameter that leaves ~4 mm between rims - the lamps visually touch. Total lamp span 935 mm, overall 994 mm including the aluminium end mounts. On a 1240 mm Rhino-Rack Pioneer 6 that leaves 123 mm of bare rail each side; on a 1380 mm platform, 193 mm. Section 154 mm high x 85 mm deep. Weight 11.34 kg, i.e. 38% of the JB74's 30 kg dynamic roof limit before the rack itself. KC publishes no Rhino-Rack or ARB platform bracket for it - the only rack-specific KC package is the 8-light 50in bundled with a Yakima LNL mount (91398).

layouts.desc: Six INDIVIDUAL 6 inch KC rounds (Daylighter, SlimLite or Pro6 single) evenly spread across a 1300 mm roof rack front rail
layouts.note: COMPUTED, not observed. Method: 1300 mm rail, 40 mm end margin each side leaves 1220 mm; six 158 mm lamps occupy 948 mm; the remaining 272 mm divided into five equal gaps gives 54.4 mm between rims, hence a 212.4 mm centre pitch. This is the layout that looks deliberately spaced rather than ganged. Lamp depth drives how the rack front edge reads: SlimLite 73 mm, Pro6 79 mm, Daylighter 137 mm.

layouts.desc: Six INDIVIDUAL 6 inch KC rounds packed tight to mimic the Pro6 bar look, on a 1240-1380 mm rail
layouts.note: COMPUTED. 170 mm pitch leaves 12 mm between 158 mm rims - as close as separate ball-mount pedestals will practically allow. Total span 908 mm, so 166-236 mm of rail free at each end. Use this when the configurator wants the 'smiley row' silhouette without buying the Pro6 bar.

layouts.desc: STEDI amber bar along the front edge of a JB74 roof rack or on the gutter line
layouts.note: Three real positions, each a different silhouette. (1) On a Rhino-Rack platform via STEDI's own 4 mm stainless platform bracket (AUD 129): the bracket holds the bar either DIRECTLY IN FRONT of the platform - the bar becomes the rack's front face - or DIRECTLY UNDERNEATH it, where only 63 mm of ST3K peeks below the rack edge. (2) On the roof gutters via the MG-X gutter brackets (AUD 129), sized for a 52in bar, which puts the bar just above the windscreen header with no rack at all - the most common JB74 arrangement. (3) On a windscreen-header stay such as the IPF 642JM2, which is the Japanese convention. Bar-length matching: ST3K 51.5in = 1300 mm, ST4K 52in = 1320 mm, ST2K TOUCH 40in = 1016 mm, ST3K 41.5in = 1055 mm. A JB74 platform is 1240-1380 mm wide, so 1300-1320 mm is full-width and ~1050 mm is deliberately inset.

layouts.desc: The three physically distinct ways a light sits relative to the JB74 grille
layouts.note: IN FRONT: STEDI Rally Bar (63 mm stainless tube hoop) or the IPF JS-001 lamp stay - the lamp stands clear of the bodywork. IN THE APERTURE: IPF EXJ-12 markers pushed into the factory grille openings, or the Jimny Outfitters Express Grille Deluxe which replaces the grille panel with one carrying two 6 W bars - the light is in the grille plane. BEHIND: the Bushranger NHBGS450LB kit, a 717 mm bar on body-mounted brackets behind the LOWER grille, trimmed into the plastic lower radiator shroud and invisible from a three-quarter view. STEDI makes no behind-grille bracket for the Jimny at all.

estimates.claim: The JB74 factory front grille panel is roughly 720-740 mm wide by roughly 160-180 mm tall.
estimates.reasoning: No maker publishes it - not Suzuki, not APIO, not KLC, not JAOS, not any of the 30 aftermarket grilles on jimny-parts.com. The one numeric anchor reached was a search-result snippet for an OEM JB74 front bar grille shipping in a 760 x 200 x 100 mm carton (myautoparts.com.au; the product page itself now 404s, so this is second-hand). Allowing ~15 mm of packing each side gives a panel around 730 x 170 mm. A second, weaker anchor points the same way: the Bushranger 717 mm bar is described as fitting behind the LOWER grille rather than the upper panel, which is consistent with the upper grille being only ~730 mm wide and largely blocked by the Suzuki emblem. DO NOT treat this as a dimension - measure it off the model or a scaled photo before using it.

estimates.claim: The factory grille has at least four usable openings across its width; if evenly distributed across a ~730 mm panel the aperture pitch is on the order of 145 mm.
estimates.reasoning: IPF's EXJ-12 kit contains exactly FOUR markers and IPF says they push into the grille's existing openings, anywhere among them. Four markers in a symmetric row across a ~730 mm panel implies apertures at roughly 730/5 = 146 mm intervals. I could NOT confirm the actual slot count of the stock JB64/JB74 grille from any source - every query for it returned aftermarket 縦スリット replacement grilles rather than a description of the factory part. The commonly repeated 'five vertical slots' figure is NOT verified here and is not recorded as fact.

estimates.claim: STEDI ST3K body depth ~55-65 mm, ~75-85 mm over the side brackets and fixings.
estimates.reasoning: STEDI publishes height for every ST3K length (51 mm bare, 63 mm with side brackets) and depth for none of them, across the AU, CA and US sites and every reseller reached. The estimate comes from STEDI's own other single-row bar, the ST1K, which publishes 38 mm height against 80 mm depth where that 80 mm demonstrably includes the heavy-duty bottom mounts. Scaling that mount allowance onto a 51 mm face gives the range above. A weight check is inconclusive: ST3K is 3.27 kg/m against ST1K's 2.36 kg/m and ST4K's 5.02 kg/m, which brackets it but does not fix the section.

estimates.claim: Bushranger Night Hawk VLI SR 28in section ~50-60 mm high x ~60-75 mm deep including the sliding feet.
estimates.reasoning: See the dimNote on bushranger_behind_grille_jb74. Derived from LED pitch (21 emitters over ~640 mm = 30.5 mm) and linear mass (2.93 kg/m), both of which sit between STEDI's ST1K and ST3K, whose heights are 38 mm and 51 mm.

corrections: STEDI makes NO grille light, inner-grille bracket or behind-grille bracket for the Suzuki Jimny. Their inner-grille and lower-grille bracket range covers Ford Ranger / Raptor / Everest, Prado 150 and 250, Hilux N80 and N80 Rogue / GR Sport, Y62 Patrol, LandCruiser 300 and VW Amarok - and stops there. The whole STEDI Jimny catalogue is four items: the Rally Bar (ST-11-JMN-001, AUD 325), the JB74 dynamic LED side marker (LEDCONV-JIMNY-SM, AUD 45), a JB64/JB74 piggy-back wiring adapter (AUD 36) and a Suzuki push switch. The behind-grille product for a JB74 is Bushranger's, not STEDI's.

There is no STEDI 'Micro V2' LIGHT BAR family. Micro V2 is a flood / work / camp light line (7.8in, 13.9in, 26in) plus a Micro Touch dual-colour variant. It is not part of the driving-light-bar range and STEDI does not list it among light bars.
There is no STEDI 'ST3K amber LED' or 'ST4K amber LED' variant. Amber on those families is a removable filter cover only. The only STEDI bar with factory colour in the lens is the ST1K 21.5in Yellow.
The ST1K 13.5in has NO yellow version - only the 21.5in does.

'ST3303 Pro colour caps' are END CAPS, not lens covers and not per-LED cube caps. They colour the two ends of the housing in yellow/red/blue/green/sandy tan/orange, AUD 20 a pair. The amber LENS cover is a separate part, also from AUD 20.

KC HiLiTES does not sell a six-light Daylighter bar or a six-light SlimLite bar. The only factory six-round assembly is the Gravity Pro6 6-light bar (91307) - and its Titan equivalent (91416). Six Daylighters or six SlimLites means six separate lamps on six separate mounts.
The KC 'Pro6 Gravity LED' single light is 91302 and the spread pair is 91305 - 'Pro6 Gravity' is a Gravity-series Pro6, not a separate Pro6 Gravity family.
KC publishes no Rhino-Rack or ARB roof-platform bracket for any Pro6 bar. The only roof-rack-specific KC part reached is 91398, the 8-light 50in Pro6 bundled with a Yakima LNL platform mount.
ozjimny.com.au no longer exists - the domain 301-redirects to jurassicjimnyrentals.com. Any ozjimny AUD price already in jb74-accessory-atlas.json is now unsourceable.

STEDI's own 'Suzuki Jimny JB74 LED upgrade guide' blog post does NOT cover light bars, the Rally Bar, grille mounting or amber options - it is about headlight/interior/side-marker bulb conversions. Do not cite it as a fitment source.

STEDI publishes ST4K heights that CHANGE with length (22in = 87 mm, 52in = 110 mm) and ST3303 Pro sections that change too (11in 89x85, 23.3in 87x98, 28.2in 98x105). A single cross-section per family would be wrong.
STEDI's own two pages disagree on two lengths: ST1K 21.5in is 546 mm on the product page and 550 mm on the series page; ST3303 Pro 11in is 280 mm on the product page and 246 mm on the series page.
